title: Premium Paving
subtitle: Website, Google Business Profile, and Suffolk County competitive position — with a phased plan to win organic search and launch Local Services Ads.

metrics.s: 121 reviews — ahead of the benchmark competitor

headToHead.title: Head to head — Premium Paving vs Affordable Patio
headToHead.note: Ratings and review counts are close. The gap is infrastructure, not satisfaction.

phases.label: Phase 1
phases.name: Foundation
phases.thesis: Cheap, fast, and prerequisite to everything downstream.
tasks: Consolidate to one phone number across every property and citation
Resolve the duplicate Facebook page
Restructure the GBP: primary category, secondary set, Services list, service areas
Relocate and hide the pin — staged, after review export
Rebuild citations to match across Angi, HomeAdvisor, Thumbtack, Yelp, BBB, Apple, Bing
File redressal reports on spam and duplicate listings
Confirm domain, DNS, hosting, and GBP ownership

phases.label: Phase 2
phases.name: Rebuild
phases.thesis: Three service silos, then the geographic layer — asphalt and masonry first, where nobody is competing.
tasks: Asphalt silo: driveways, aprons, resurfacing, commercial lots, striping
Pavers silo: patios, walkways, pool surrounds, walls, steps, outdoor kitchens, fire features
Masonry silo: chimneys, tuckpointing, stoops, veneer, sidewalks, foundations, drainage
Asphalt × hamlet pages first — uncontested, fastest ranking wins
Masonry repair × hamlet second — uncontested, competitor structurally locked out
Pavers × hamlet last: 15–20 priority hamlets only, built to a quality bar
East End weighted throughout, with licensing content attached
Replace every stock photo with real project photography

phases.label: Phase 3
phases.name: Conversion parity
phases.thesis: Affordable Patio has these and Premium Paving has none. Close the gap.
tasks: The project estimator — see section 9
Financing page and lender partner
Warranty statement, publicly stated
Estimate turnaround commitment, publicly stated
Process / step-by-step page
Meet the team — his reviews should name people the way theirs do
Jobs-in-progress equivalent — copy the process, not just the page
Reviews surfaced site-wide, segmented by hamlet and service line

phases.label: Phase 4
phases.name: Content
phases.thesis: Own the half of the cost universe the competitor left open.
tasks: Asphalt and masonry cost guides
Asphalt vs pavers vs concrete, framed for Long Island freeze-thaw
Drainage, grading, and base prep — technical trust content
Southampton and East Hampton permitting realities
The licensing and credentials trust page

phases.label: Phase 5
phases.name: Compounding
phases.thesis: The levers that keep paying after the build is done.
tasks: Review engine targeting 8–10 net per month — highest single-lever ROI
LocalBusiness + Service + FAQPage + Review schema throughout
Weekly GBP posts; geo-tagged photo cadence
Call tracking and full conversion instrumentation
Answer the phone live — their reviews prove this wins jobs outright
